verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is indirect. A release note announces a capability scoped to a specific region (UAE Central, Abu Dhabi), which implies regional deployment and region-specific rollout. A community comment mentions configurations 'in any region globally'. Neither shows a published region list or a per-region service-availability reference an operations lead could check before committing. missing for 10: a documented published region list, a per-region service availability matrix or lookup (console/CLI/API), and independent corroboration that availability can be checked ahead of deployment.
